deployments_detail.use: CodeFusion Studio 2.0 and AutoML for Embedded: embedded software development platform enabling complete end-to-end AI workflows, letting developers bring/train and deploy AI models across ADI's heterogeneous edge hardware with model compatibility checking and inference performance profiling. [Analog Devices (CodeFusion Studio, VS Code integration; AutoML w/ Antmicro Kenning)]
EdgeBench cloud platform for benchmarking/deploying AI/ML on ADI edge hardware; "Physical Intelligence" edge-AI smart sensors for predictive maintenance

ADI OtoSense Smart Motor Sensor: AI/ML edge machine-health platform for predictive maintenance, detecting motor anomalies and forecasting maintenance cycles. Deployed at named customers including Nissei (soft-serve homogenizer monitoring), Rengo (paper/pulp), and Kanadevia (waste-to-energy plant). [Analog Devices (ADI OtoSense; tech from acquired Test Motors)]

ADI adopts NVIDIA Jetson Thor and uses NVIDIA Holoscan Sensor Bridge for physical AI: connecting ADI sensor data (cameras, radar, lidar) directly to GPU memory with ultralow latency to bring reasoning to real-world robotics/humanoid applications, combining ADI's precision signal chain with Jetson Thor reasoning. [NVIDIA (Jetson Thor, Holoscan Sensor Bridge)]

Digital Factory of the Future: ADI's manufacturing strategy deploying AI at the edge for autonomous optimization, using AI-enabled sensors (e.g. Voyager4 wireless condition-monitoring platform) for anomaly/motor-health detection to improve quality control and productivity in its own plants. [Analog Devices (edge AI, Voyager4)]

Physical intelligence robotics demonstrations at NVIDIA GTC 2026 with Synopsys and NVIDIA: software-defined humanoid hand combining ADI next-gen tactile sensor with precision signal chain and motor control, plus collision/soft-body simulation bridging simulation to real-world robotics. [Analog Devices + NVIDIA + Synopsys (also MANUS gloves)]

Collaboration with Kawasaki Heavy Industries, NVIDIA, Microsoft and Fujitsu to develop physical AI for robotics (ADI named as a signal-chain/sensing collaborator in the multi-company physical AI effort). [Kawasaki, NVIDIA, Microsoft, Fujitsu, Analog Devices]
Applied generative AI to accelerate an internal R&D process (a 2-year process involving 400+ steps/people), presented as a business-transformation case study claiming $45M in ROI. [none disclosed]

'Ask LRO' AI-powered legal chatbot / intake assistant built on Checkbox, serving as a single legal front door for 25,000+ employees across 40+ countries. Auto-triages and routes requests, self-serves NDAs, conflict-of-interest forms, onboarding checklists, patent and matter-change requests. [Checkbox.ai]

Strategic partnership with Teradyne Robotics (Universal Robots, MiR) to deploy edge-based AI/ML collaborative and autonomous mobile robots in ADI's own semiconductor fabrication and backend operations (collaborative automation initiative), contributing intelligent motion, position sensing, functional safety and robotic vision. [Teradyne Robotics (Universal Robots, Mobile Industrial Robots) + Analog Devices]
